audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 is consistent with 52.22% over 948 games and with Brand having no dash, no escape and a 625-range Conflagration as his only close-quarters answer to a 600-range refunding dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike claimed Irelia lands a knockup. Irelia's R deals damage, Marks, and leaves a slowing wall — no displacement.
audit.why: A fabricated knockup changes how a player commits into Pyroclasm.
audit.corrected: R Marks him at 950 range and refunds Bladesurge; Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times and stacks Blaze to max.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] called the stun 'his stun (W)'. Sear is Q; W is Pillar of Flame. The early paragraph also said the stun 'requires landing W first' — any Brand spell applies Blaze, and Blaze is what arms Sear.
audit.why: Wrong slot and wrong arming condition mislead the dodge.
audit.corrected: Sear (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, 1050 range) stuns only a target already ablaze; Blaze comes from any of his spells and stacks to 3, then detonates.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and spikes[0]/early both claimed Pillar of Flame has a 'long cooldown'.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — short, not long. Sear 8-6s, Conflagration 13-9s, Pyroclasm 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the cooldowns field and the false 'long cooldown' claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, and dosFull[1].t promised 'after his escape is spent' when Brand has no escape.
audit.why: Lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED plus a title that describes an ability the enemy does not own.
audit.corrected: Title and both bodies rewritten to Brand's actual kit.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Defiant Dance like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sear only stuns a target already ablaze and it is back in 8s at rank 1, 6s maxed — the Blaze from his 10s Pillar of Flame is what arms it, so break contact after eating W. - Conflagration is 13s at rank 1. - Pyroclasm is 100s. Hold Defiant Dance for it.

edits.before: E-stun after his escape is spent
Q-reset through two low minions onto his chest, four-stack autos, E-stun the retreat — the wave-funded all-in he budgeted zero for.
edits.after: Brand has no dash: land E at 850 range and the stun Marks him, so Bladesurge refunds and the chase after it costs you nothing.

edits.before: Dashing in under-stacked with W down — Irelia without the engine is a melee minion with a famous haircut.
edits.after: At 1050 Sear range with no minions to dash through, you are a target collecting Blaze stacks for free.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze on you from 1050 range, arming Sear off it, and detonating the stack while you are stunned.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — the wave funds dives no cooldown can, and your R turns skirmishes into no-exit interviews.
edits.after: Carry by removing his casting room: he has no dash, so an 850-range E-stun and Bladesurge resets keep him stuck in melee.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q resets and stay relevant through stacked windows.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score, stop walking into Pillar of Flame to farm — take the minions Bladesurge can reach, never let Blaze sit at three stacks, and re-enter once his 100s Pyroclasm is on the clock.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: crash waves into Brand's face, stun the answers, and surf resets through every river fight.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the stack: he cannot farm with you inside 600 range, and every recall he takes is a plate and a wave you own.

edits.before: You are the front-to-back blender: Q through their line, stun the carries, and let the marks ground the peel.
edits.after: You are the front-to-back blender: Q through their line, E-stun the carries, and let R's wall slow whoever peels.

edits.before: Best wave: a slow push of low-HP minions — every one is a dash and the crash is an all-in announcement you control. Worst wave: a crashed wave and an empty lane — no minions, no dashes, no Irelia. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: a slow push of low-HP minions between you and him — each is a Bladesurge and the crash is an all-in you control. Worst wave: a shoved lane with nothing to dash through while he drops Pillar of Flame from 900. Crash timing: crash while Conflagration and Sear are both down, then plate or reset.

edits.before: All-in the instant his stun (W) or root lands on a minion instead of you
edits.after: All-in the instant Sear (Q) misses you — no Blaze on you, no stun for 6-8s

edits.before: Brand's Pillar of Flame has a long cooldown and low base damage before he stacks Ability Haste, so a level 3 dash-in punishes any Q he whiffs at melee range.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame is only a 10s cooldown and Sear 8s, but both need range he cannot hold, so a level 3 dash-in the moment Sear whiffs punishes him before either returns.

edits.before: Pyroclasm bounces off you and back for extra damage, but Vanguard's Edge still closes the gap fast enough that you land the knockup before his combo fully resolves.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times and stacks Blaze to max, but Vanguard's Edge Marks him at 950 range and refunds Bladesurge, so you are on him before the bounces finish.

edits.before: Brand is a stationary mage with no dash and no hard escape, which is exactly what your dive kit is built to punish. His Pillar of Flame has real cooldown and mana costs before level 6, so every whiffed poke is a window to Q in and start a trade he can't win at melee range. Push the wave and threaten all-ins on cooldown — he has no way to disengage once Bladesurge closes the distance, and his stun requires landing W first, which is hard against someone walking straight at him.
edits.after: Brand is a stationary mage with no dash and no hard escape, which is exactly what your dive kit is built to punish. Sear is his only stun and it needs you already ablaze, so break contact after eating Pillar of Flame and the 8s stun has nothing to arm it. Push the wave and threaten all-ins on cooldown — he cannot disengage once Bladesurge closes 600 range, and every low minion between you is another reset, which is why walking straight at him beats respecting his 1050 range.

edits.before: Pyroclasm at 6 adds real burst if he lands the bounce, but it doesn't give him mobility, so Vanguard's Edge still gets you into range before his combo fully lands. Keep pressuring every time his Pillar of Flame goes on cooldown and force fights before he can rotate through his full rotation; you win these skirmishes as long as you're the one initiating. Roams favor you slightly since Brand has no way to catch you if you leave lane, while you can flash-Q onto him if he tries the same.
edits.after: Pyroclasm at 6 adds real burst if he lands the bounce, but it doesn't give him mobility, so Vanguard's Edge still gets you into range before his combo lands. Pressure the instant Conflagration is spent — it is his 13s answer at 625 range and the only thing that punishes you standing on him, and you win every skirmish you initiate. Roams favour you since Brand cannot catch you if you leave lane, while your E-stun turns any gank onto him into a kill.

notes: packet suspectNames flagged 'His Pillar of Flame' in early as a near-miss; it is the correct Riot name and was a false positive — the real defect in that sentence was the claim that W has a 'long cooldown' (it is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and that the stun requires landing W. Both fixed. Irelia's R has no knockup; spikes[1] corrected. Level chart untouched — packet and page agree on all seven rows.
